One-shot: the whole utterance is generated before playback starts. 300 characters per request; longer text is split by the reader. English and Chinese only. No streaming or native cancellation. On one arm64 phone, an external app_process run measured RTF about 2.1 and about 1.02 GB peak memory; an in-app instrumentation test has since passed.
